lines.t: Your love is gentle like the morning light
Faithful as the rising sun
It fills my heart with peace and hope
And reminds me I'm your own
You held me close when I felt all alone
Your peace washed over me
Now every breath inside my lungs
Wants to sing your melody
This is real love
This is whole love
This is true love
Lord, I love you so much more than anything
I just wanna sing of how much I love you Before you knit me in my mother's womb
You knew me and loved me Oh Lord, I feel your love
Your love will always endure, it will never leave
Forever I sing of all the joy you bring to me
Every morning when the sun appears
I see your kindness in the sky
Every moment that my heart beats on
Reminds me that you're always by my side
This is real love
This is whole love
This is true love
Lord, I love you so much more than anything
I just wanna sing of how much I love you Before you knit me in my mother's womb
You knew me and loved me Oh Lord, I feel your love
Your love is deeper than the ocean Higher than the stars above
Nothing in this world could ever separate me from your love
Lord, forever I am yours and you are mine
Bound by love divine
This is real love, this is whole love
This is true love
Lord, I love you so much more than anything
Oh Lord, I feel your love
Ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah
